plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-10-01 from the official CBU Major Planning Guide 'Honors Program' 4-Year Sample Plan (California Baptist University Academic Advising, 2026-2027 guides). Every course code, title, and credit value copied from the guide's sample-plan tab; per-term unit totals verified against the guide's stated totals (31 units total). 'X or Y' slots use the first-listed option. General Education and Elective placeholders are choice slots. Prerequisites are listed on the guide's requirements tab, not in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty. Empty Summer terms from the source plan are omitted.
